about: Permanent tests for every preset question the app offers as a button: the 22 sidebar starters in lib/categories.ts (the welcome-screen examples and the example buttons after greetings and off-topic fallbacks are a subset of these). A preset must ALWAYS be answered from our sources, never fall back (Entry 20). `npm run check:presets` (offline) fails if a preset in lib/categories.ts is missing here. Run live with: TESTS_FILE=tests/preset-questions.json RESULTS_FILE=docs/test-results-presets.md npm run test:questions (the app must be running). Patterns are case-insensitive regular expressions, checked against the answer text plus the titles of its source chips.

tests.question: When is the add/drop deadline for spring?
tests.expected_behavior: Answers from Key Dates and Deadlines (both listed dates, per our conflict rule).

tests.question: How do I check my financial aid status?
tests.expected_behavior: Answers from the MyCSULB financial aid page (To Do List / Student Center).

tests.expected_behavior: Answers from the Student Financial Services How-To Guides (Make a Payment).
